text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I headed to the cafeteria for 
lunch, there was an Umamusume making a 
fuss in front of the wall display.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhh~! First place! Sweep, you're soooo 
amazinggg!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Sorry for making so much noise. 
Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san is so strong and dazzling; she's 
the Tiara Umamusume I've always looked up 
to.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yearning, huh. Her eyes gazing at the 
screen are indeed sparkling brightly, 
radiating her immense passion.
choice_data_list: What is it about them that you look up to?
What is it about them that you admire?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A little bit of everything, I'd say... Her 
running and her mental strength are both 
so cool!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the replay has started... You should 
watch too, Trainer! Sweep-san was 
incredible!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Just before the final corner, near the 
very back of the pack... Ah, she's making 
her move now! Here it comes! She's gonna 
zoom right to the front!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Five, seven, no, she's passed twelve 
runners at once! Incredible, straight to 
the front! And she's still pulling away! 
Waaahhh~! Waaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! But isn't it amazing?! Just 
watching them makes my heart race like 
magic was cast on me...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I really do want to become like that too! 
I wonder what I have to do to get 
there...!
choice_data_list: Let's hurry to the training track!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Research... That really is the quickest 
path to uncovering the secret of strength, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Advice noted! I'll go study Sweep's 
running form frame-by-frame right away.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Watching it normally is something I've 
done over 300 times…… I hope I can make 
some good discoveries.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
You're so right...! To get stronger, it's 
practice first, practice second, and 
practice, practice, practice for three, 
four, and five!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the advice. I'll get right to 
it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She dashed off toward the training track 
in the blink of an eye...
